items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, I don't think it was William. It was quite a while later... You don't remember your dates exactly, you say, on some of that.

ctx.x: Well, anyway, he must have come back a few months later, maybe for a single concert or something.

Well, I don't think it was William. It was quite a while later, if I remember rightly. That was 1946. He went to Chicago later that year. In the fall, he went to Chicago. I don't remember that he went to New York that next fall. You don't remember your dates exactly, you say, on some of that.
No, I'm very vague about the dates.
